introduction_markdown: You are required to answer FIVE questions, choosing THREE from Section A and TWO from Section B. All the questions carry equal marks allocated to parts of questions are indicated. Extra questions answered from each section shall NOT be marked. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. Duration: two and a half hours.
incertitudes: Le PDF a 3 pages (page de garde, Section A, Section B), toutes lues en image ; rien ne manque. Filigranes et publicites ignores. Identite verifiee : Ordinary Level, juin 2019, Human Biology, Paper 2, code 0565, deux heures et demie.

Choix : la page de garde impose de repondre a 5 questions, 3 parmi la Section A (questions 1 a 5) et 2 parmi la Section B (questions 6 a 9). Traduit en regles_choix : SECTION A 3 sur 5, SECTION B 2 sur 4 (identique dans tous les fichiers). La phrase imprimee « All the questions carry equal marks allocated to parts of questions are indicated » est recopiee telle quelle (sans ponctuation entre marks et allocated).

Le sujet imprime les points par sous-partie en fin de question (ex. « (7, 5, 8 marks) ») ; ils sont repartis ici sur les sous-questions dans le meme ordre, sans rien corriger. Les 9 questions totalisent 20 points avec ces valeurs imprimees.
Le sujet ne contient aucune figure. Les schemas demandes au candidat sont decrits dans le corrige, sans figure.

questions.enonce_markdown:
Why would you recommend the creation of the following community?

(i) Geriatric home

(ii) Gymnasium

(iii) Mortuary *(8 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) **Geriatric home**: it is a **home for old (aged) people** who can no longer take care of themselves or have no relatives to look after them. It provides them with **shelter, food, medical care and company**, and relieves families of the burden of caring for them.

(ii) **Gymnasium**: it is a place equipped for **physical exercise**. It helps people to **keep fit and healthy**, to **build muscles**, to **reduce body weight (obesity)**, to **lower the risk of heart diseases** and diabetes, and to **relieve stress**.

(iii) **Mortuary**: it is a place where **dead bodies are kept in cold chambers** (refrigerated). It **slows down decay** until burial, **prevents the spread of diseases and bad smell** from decomposing bodies, and allows **identification of bodies and post-mortem examination** to find the cause of death.

questions.enonce_markdown:
State the harmful effects of each of the following to the society

(i) Prostitution

(ii) Excessive Alcohol consumption

(iii) Defecation in streams *(12 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) **Prostitution**:

- **Spread of sexually transmitted infections** (HIV/AIDS, gonorrhoea, syphilis).
- **Unwanted pregnancies**, abortions and abandoned or street children.
- **Moral decay**, breaking up of homes and families.
- Leads to **crime, drug abuse and violence**.

(ii) **Excessive alcohol consumption**:

- **Damages the liver (cirrhosis), the brain and the nervous system**, and causes addiction.
- Causes **road and other accidents**, **violence and crime**.
- **Poverty and neglect of the family** (money wasted on drink), **reduced productivity** at work, and **domestic violence**.
- Leads to **loss of self-control and irresponsible sexual behaviour**.

(iii) **Defecation in streams**:

- **Pollutes the water**, so that people who use it get **water-borne diseases** (cholera, typhoid, dysentery, hookworm and other worm infections).
- The **organic matter is decomposed by bacteria which use up the oxygen**, so **fish and other aquatic life die**.
- **Bad smell** and an unpleasant environment; it attracts **flies**, which spread germs.
- The water becomes **unfit to drink and for domestic use**, which causes **expense for treatment**.
